flawed_step: 0028: Bipartiteness does not imply that an ear’s two endpoints have different colors; they may have the same color.
assessment_summary:
0001 — JUSTIFIED: This is only a heading.
0002 — JUSTIFIED: It announces the two directions of the equivalence.
0003 — JUSTIFIED: It correctly completes the proof plan.
0004 — JUSTIFIED: The stated characterization of 2-connectivity is standard in the problem’s setting.
0005 — JUSTIFIED: The definition of a plane graph is correct.
0006 — JUSTIFIED: The definition of a face is correct.
0007 — JUSTIFIED: This adequately describes a face boundary.
0008 — JUSTIFIED: It begins the standard definition of bipartiteness.
0009 — JUSTIFIED: It correctly completes that definition.
0010 — JUSTIFIED: This is the heading for the forward implication.
0011 — JUSTIFIED: It assumes bipartiteness and selects an arbitrary face.
0012 — JUSTIFIED: In a 2-connected plane graph, every face boundary is a cycle.
0013 — JUSTIFIED: Although compressed, the appeal to absence of cut vertices supports the preceding standard fact.
0014 — JUSTIFIED: It validly labels the vertices of the facial cycle in cyclic order.
0015 — JUSTIFIED: Vertices along every cycle in a bipartite graph alternate between the two parts.
0016 — JUSTIFIED: The stated color pattern and its dependence on the parity of k are correct.
0017 — JUSTIFIED: Since vk is adjacent to v1, it lies in the opposite part, forcing k to be even.
0018 — JUSTIFIED: A k-vertex cycle has k edges, so even k makes it an even cycle.
0019 — JUSTIFIED: This is the heading for the converse implication.
0020 — JUSTIFIED: It correctly states the converse hypothesis.
0021 — JUSTIFIED: Constructing a proper 2-coloring would establish bipartiteness.
0022 — JUSTIFIED: A 2-connected graph admits an open ear decomposition.
0023 — JUSTIFIED: This accurately summarizes such a decomposition.
0024 — JUSTIFIED: A facial boundary is an even cycle by hypothesis and may serve as the initial cycle.
0025 — JUSTIFIED: Every even cycle has a proper 2-coloring.
0026 — JUSTIFIED: This is a legitimate induction hypothesis.
0027 — JUSTIFIED: It correctly describes adding an ear whose endpoints are in H.
0028 — NOT JUSTIFIED: The endpoints of an ear need not receive different colors in a bipartite H.
0029 — NOT JUSTIFIED: Alternating colors along an odd-length path gives its endpoints opposite colors, not the same color.
0030 — NOT JUSTIFIED: The claimed monochromatic-edge conflict for an odd path rests on the reversed parity assertion in 0029.
0031 — NOT JUSTIFIED: A face created at an intermediate ear-decomposition stage need not itself be a face of G, so the hypothesis does not directly imply that its boundary is even; the needed union-of-faces parity lemma is not proved.
0032 — JUSTIFIED: Geometrically, a plane ear lies within a face of H and a resulting boundary consists of the ear and a boundary path in H, though this does not establish evenness.
0033 — JUSTIFIED: Conditional on that boundary being even, the two path lengths must have the same parity.
0034 — JUSTIFIED: This correctly spells out the same-parity alternatives.
0035 — JUSTIFIED: In a bipartite graph, same-colored endpoints are joined only by even paths and differently colored endpoints only by odd paths.
0036 — JUSTIFIED: Conditional on the unproved even-boundary premise, the required parity of P would agree with the endpoint colors.
0037 — NOT JUSTIFIED: Extendability would follow from the parity relation, but that relation has not been established for intermediate faces.
0038 — NOT JUSTIFIED: The unconditional extension claim relies on the false endpoint discussion and the unproved intermediate-face parity assertion.
0039 — NOT JUSTIFIED: Alternating colors along P works only when its length has the parity required by its already-colored endpoints, which has not been proved.
0040 — NOT JUSTIFIED: The induction cannot conclude because its inductive extension step is unsupported.
0041 — NOT JUSTIFIED: The forward direction was proved, but the converse was not.
0042 — NOT JUSTIFIED: The second summarized implication remains unproved.
0043 — NOT JUSTIFIED: The claimed completion does not follow because of the converse gap.
0044 — NOT JUSTIFIED: The theorem is true, but this conclusion is not established by the supplied proof.
0045 — JUSTIFIED: This is merely a stray page or footnote marker and contains no mathematical inference.
